updates.at_start: Check for updates when MapWorks starts
updates.at_start.tooltip: Once a day at most, MapWorks asks GitHub for a new release when it starts, and only says something when there is one
updates.skip.tooltip: Do not mention this version again when MapWorks starts
updates.checking: Looking for a new version on GitHub...
@updates.current: {version} is the version number, shown unchanged
updates.no_release: There is no release on GitHub yet.
updates.available.title: MapWorks {version} is available
updates.available.published: It was published on {published, date, long}.
updates.install.hint: Install downloads {asset} ({size}), checks it, closes MapWorks and starts the new version with the open project. Projects, maps and settings stay as they are.
@updates.install.hint: {asset} is the file name of the download and {size} its size, both shown unchanged
updates.install.problem: {problem} The release page has the download.
@updates.install.problem: {problem} is a sentence that says why MapWorks cannot install it itself
updates.installing.title: Installing MapWorks {version}
updates.installing.message: MapWorks closes now and starts again with the new version.
@updates.status.updated: {previous} and {current} are version numbers, shown unchanged
updates.status.failed: The update could not be installed. MapWorks {version} is still in place.
updates.status.failed_reason: The update could not be installed: {reason} MapWorks {version} is still in place.
@updates.status.failed_reason: {reason} is a message from the installer script, in English
updates.check_failed: GitHub could not be asked for a new version: {reason}
@updates.check_failed: {reason} is the message of the system error, in English
updates.problem.editor: Updates install only into a built MapWorks, not into the Unity editor.
updates.problem.no_asset: The release has no {asset} to install.
@updates.problem.no_asset: {asset} is a file name suffix, shown unchanged
updates.problem.not_writable: MapWorks may not write into its folder {folder}.
updates.install_failed.title: MapWorks {version} could not be installed
@updates.install_failed.stays: {reason} is the message of the system error, in English
updates.installer_failed: The installer could not be started: {reason}
@updates.installer_failed: {reason} is the message of the system error, in English
